race.comment: Keen on the chances of NAIFAH (1) here. She was poor at Flemington last start but did get forced into the inferior ground at her first go down the straight, and her fresh run splitting Point Barrow and Bridal Waltz at Caulfield is outstanding form. SWIFT FORCE (4) did beat NAIFAH home comfortably at Flemington but that was over 1100m. She has won twice over 1200m but they've been in weaker races in Tasmania. She'll likely lead and give a sight but may be a touch vulnerable late. TORSHEEN (5) was backed off the map at Flemington first up, holding her ground for sixth. She has form around NAIFAH and can improve. ROHESIA (2) was good fresh just behind TORSHEEN and will be running on while MARSEPT (8) was a soft winner here fresh and has beaten a couple of these home in the past.
